description: NOAA Atlas 14 - Precipitation Frequency Data Server (PFDS) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Weather Service | Hydrometeorological Design Studies Center. This point-and-click interface delivers NOAA Atlas 14 precipitation frequency estimates and associated information. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Energy and Utilities, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
